# 🕵️‍♂️ AgentTrace 

[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11+-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org)
[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.104+-00a393.svg)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com)
[![DuckDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/DuckDB-OLAP-yellow.svg)](https://duckdb.org)
[![React Flow](https://img.shields.io/badge/React_Flow-UI-ff0072.svg)](https://reactflow.dev)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

> **Deterministic Time-Travel Debugging & Observability for Multi-Agent AI Systems.**

When autonomous LLM agents fail in production, standard logging is insufficient. You cannot reproduce the bug because LLMs are non-deterministic, and you cannot simply re-run the code because agents trigger irreversible real-world side effects (e.g., executing SQL `DELETE`, sending emails, charging credit cards).

**AgentTrace solves this.** It is an enterprise APM (Application Performance Monitoring) tool that auto-instruments LangGraph and LangChain applications. It calculates microsecond state deltas and records external tool payloads (VCR Cassettes), allowing engineers to perform offline, step-by-step state injections to fix agent hallucinations—**with zero network calls or API token costs.**

---

## ⚡ Offline State Injection

AgentTrace allows developers to visually inspect a hallucinated LLM context, manually fix the JSON payload in the UI, and dynamically resume the graph execution offline using cached side-effects.

### Core Architecture Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Agent as 🤖 AI Agent
    participant SDK as 🛡️ AgentTrace SDK
    participant DB as 🦆 DuckDB Engine
    participant UI as 💻 React UI

    Agent->>SDK: Execute Tool / Change State

    alt Live Recording
        SDK->>DB: Save trace & tool responses
    else Offline Replay
        SDK->>DB: Fetch recorded tool data
        DB-->>SDK: Return cached response
        SDK-->>Agent: Inject response (No API call)
    end

    UI->>DB: Fetch timeline data
    DB-->>UI: Return state history
    UI-->>UI: Render interactive graph
```

---

## 🛠️ Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you have the following installed on your system:
* **Python 3.11+**
* **Node.js 18+** (for the React Frontend)
* **Git**

---

## 🚀 Installation & Local Setup

Follow these exact steps to run the complete AgentTrace stack locally.

### 1. Clone the Repository
```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/agent-trace.git
cd agent-trace
```

### 2. Setup the Python Backend (FastAPI + DuckDB)
Create a virtual environment and install the required core SDK and server dependencies:

```bash
# Create virtual environment
python -m venv .venv

# Activate (Windows):
.venv\Scriptsctivate
# Activate (Mac/Linux):
source .venv/bin/activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install opentelemetry-api opentelemetry-sdk redis langchain langchain-google-genai langgraph
```

### 3. Setup the React Frontend
Open a new terminal, navigate to the `ui` folder, and install the Node modules:

```bash
cd ui
npm install
```

---

## 🎮 Running the Platform

You will need three separate terminal windows to see the full architecture in action.

### Terminal 1: Start the Telemetry Backend
This boots the FastAPI server that ingests traces and serves the DuckDB OLAP data.
```bash
# Ensure your .venv is activated
python -m uvicorn server.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

### Terminal 2: Start the React Dashboard
This boots the visual time-travel debugging interface.
```bash
cd ui
npm run dev
```
👉 Open your browser to [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173)

### Terminal 3: Execute a Live AI Agent
We have included a real Gemini 2.5 Flash agent that uses LangChain tools. When you run this script, the `AgentTraceInstrumentor` will automatically intercept it and send the data to your dashboard.
```bash
# Ensure your .venv is activated
# You will be prompted to enter your Gemini API Key
python tests/test_gemini_agent.py
```
*Once the script finishes, refresh your browser at `http://localhost:5173` to see the generated execution graph and inspect the LLM's memory!*

---

## 🧪 CI/CD Integration

AgentTrace includes a PyTest runner that executes multi-agent integration suites in **Replay Mode** using recorded DuckDB cassettes. If an agent's reasoning strays from the golden path due to prompt-drift, the CI build fails instantly without making a single live API call.

```bash
# Run the regression suite
pytest tests/test_cicd_regression.py -v
```

---

## 🏗️ Systems Capabilities

* **Zero-Touch APM Instrumentor:** Global monkey-patching of LangChain tools and LangGraph state transitions via a single line of code (`AgentTraceInstrumentor().instrument()`).
* **State Delta Engine (RFC 6902):** Computes and stores JSON patches between graph nodes to minimize OLAP storage footprint.
* **Deterministic Tool Cassettes (VCR Proxy):** Caches external side-effect operations during live runs. During offline replay, it intercepts tool calls and feeds historical outputs back to the LLM.
* **Asynchronous Redis Buffer:** Built to support decoupling HTTP ingestion to handle 10,000+ concurrent agent traces without database write-lock contention.
